semantic.justification: Direct TypeScript port of the pinned md4c 0.5.3 UTF-8 block, mark-resolution and callback pipeline. Preserves source byte offsets, callback chunk boundaries and attributes, source flag defaults, reference budgets, container state and callback abort codes. All 813 complete callback streams match compiled unmodified md_parse, including 733 bundled CommonMark/extension cases. Native allocation failures, C pointer ABI and unused/uninitialized fields are not emulated. Writer callback integration remains pending; these dependency fixtures do not establish complete Writer import parity. B8TCAE adds35 observations compiled from unchanged pinned md4c source: independent HTML scan limits and line lookup over nonempty borrowed subsets of a longer initialized document. All offsets remain within the backing document. A complete public uppercase HTML callback case is also replayed. No absent reference dereference, zero-line lookup, forged parser state or full ABI/fault equivalence claim is introduced.
